cohort: Five female patients who had undergone renal transplantation and subsequently had a total of six pregnancies at a single center.
finding: Pregnancies in renal transplant recipients are high-risk but can be managed successfully with careful, multidisciplinary follow-up, resulting in births between 31 and 38 weeks with birth weights ranging from 1650 to 3190 grams.
mod_finding: All births in the study were performed by cesarean section.
